The read tool default limit 2000, so it returned all; but the printout shows the first 8 of the last slice... Hmm, `r.lines` length may be 386? No, totalLines: 644. Maybe the file read stopped at line 386 because of an encoding/newline issue? Or `r.lines.slice(-8)` gave lines with numbers 380-386 because r.lines only contains 386 entries? Strange.

Actually maybe the file contains a very long line or the reader truncates at 2000 lines/ or byte limit. totalLines 644 but lines array might be truncated at some size. Let me read with offset 600 to see the actual tail.
